- resolves the asks the last post listed;
- lists this turn's asks;
- names the round that will decide them, the first one at least 60 s after the post goes up.

**Lucy's clock: timestamp.** The two server clocks agree to within 1 s, so the real question is who owns the clock. A player who runs their own server owns its timestamps. Now that we're the GM, the time we receive a post is our clock. Bluesky's index time belongs to neither side.
